significance: Built in 1978, this Bengaluru temple gives its name to the surrounding Rajarajeshwari Nagar and is reckoned in the Tantra Chudamani as the 'ear' among the Shakti Peethas of India. Navaratri, Makara Sankranti and Deepavali are its principal festivals.
story: The site is said to be where the sage Atri and his devoted wife Anusuya lived and attained siddhi by propitiating Rajarajeshwari.
